entries.columnsContract: `product_fact_id FK, ordinal, source_basis_kind(metadata_observation|western_analysis|western_match), work_id FK, attempt_id FK, plan_id FK, event_id FK, result_id FK, capability_ref, result_schema_ref, result_digest, source_ref, source_order, evidence_id NULL, evidence_digest NULL, input_binding_digest, reference_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(product_fact_id,ordinal)`、`UNIQUE(product_fact_id,result_id)`；ordinal从0连续且恰等于Fact row的`source_ref_count`，`source_order=ordinal`，全部Work/Attempt/Plan/Event必须构成同一Run、同一Execution Basis；所有`result_digest`都逐字节复制对应`fx_event_result_bindings.result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(包含领域内digest字段的完整typed Result))`，不得复制Result内部排除自身计算的领域摘要；`input_binding_digest=SHA-256(JCS(fx_plan_nodes.input_bindings_json解析后的完整typed value))`。`metadata_observation`固定`libra.product_metadata.fetch@1 → MetadataObservation@1`，`source_ref=MetadataObservation.sourceRef`，按`sourcePriority,evidence_id`排序且Evidence列非NULL；`western_analysis`固定一至16项`libra.western.analysis.observe@1 → WesternAnalysisResult@1`后恰一项`libra.western.metadata.normalize@1 → ProductMetadataDraft@1`，observe的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisResult.resultArtifactHandle.artifactHandleId`且该Handle/digest逐字节命中同Run Artifact Registry，Evidence列非NULL；normalize的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisVariant.variantId`且Evidence列全NULL；normalize Plan input必须显式引用前序Result且最后Result逐字节等于Commit Draft；`western_match`恰一项`shared.face.reference.match@1 → PersonMatchEvidence@1`且`source_ref=PersonMatchEvidence.evidenceId`、Evidence列非NULL，其matches可为空但必须来自真实Frame→Embedding→Cluster→Match链。`reference_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-fact-source-ref@1",productFactId,ordinal,sourceBasisKind,workId,attemptId,planId,eventId,resultId,capabilityRef,resultSchemaRef,resultDigest,sourceRef,sourceOrder,evidenceId,evidenceDigest,inputBindingDigest}))`；relation存在期间所指Foundation链及Western Artifact Registry row不得GC；不得用later current Result替换历史引用

entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_package_id PK, offer_id, package_revision, libra_run_id FK, run_state_revision, run_state_digest, subject_id FK, shelf_id, acceptance_spec_id FK, acceptance_spec_record_digest, resolved_identity_fact_id, resolved_identity_revision, resolved_identity_digest, product_structure_schema_ref, product_structure_json, product_structure_digest, run_material_manifest_id FK, run_material_manifest_digest, product_material_manifest_id, product_material_manifest_digest, product_fact_manifest_id, product_fact_set_digest, product_fact_manifest_digest, artifact_manifest_id, artifact_manifest_digest, media_cast_fact_id, media_cast_fact_digest, offload_context_manifest_id, offload_context_digest, production_provenance_schema_ref, production_provenance_json, production_provenance_digest, attestation_schema_ref, attestation_json, attestation_digest, promotion_decision_digest, package_digest, state(published), published_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `on_deck_package_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.on-deck-package-id@1",libraRunId,packageRevision}))`，只作为由Run内唯一revision预派生的稳定身份；`package_digest`必须由完整`OnDeckProductPackage@1`按8.6.19公式重建，不能使用自选字段子集；`published_at_ms`是commit metadata且不进入该content digest；`offer_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-offer-id@1",onDeckPackageId,packageDigest}))`且唯一；run state pair逐字节引用immutable Run revision；四个manifest ID按8.6.21由run/package revision和manifest kind唯一派生，`product_fact_manifest_digest/artifact_manifest_digest/offload_context_digest`分别等于对应完整Manifest digest而不是仅成员set digest；typed JSON各≤`64 KiB`；Fact/Artifact set必须由Package relation重建，resolved-identity/media-cast Fact必须各唯一且Media Cast完整Fact JSON包含relations；`promotion_decision_digest`与Run/Workspace/Control historical rows重建值逐字节一致；`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,package_revision)`及`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,package_digest)`；Package row append-only，accepted/rejected终态只由`libra_delivery_receipts`表达；`INDEX(shelf_id,state,published_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_package_id FK, ordinal, material_handle_id NULL, material_key, role(primary_payload|structural_dependency|metadata_sidecar|poster|fanart|subtitle|external_audio|chapter), mount_scope_id, inode, content_hash_algorithm, content_hash, location_kind(domain_binding|workspace_handle), endpoint_id, location NULL, root_handle_ref NULL, relative_path NULL, binding_kind(libra_material_binding|workspace_material_reference), binding_revision, binding_evidence_digest, origin_intake_decision_id NULL FK, origin_offer_id NULL, origin_candidate_package_id NULL, origin_package_revision NULL, origin_package_digest NULL, origin_candidate_delivery_snapshot_digest NULL, origin_related_reference_set_digest NULL, workspace_reference_id NULL, workspace_handle_schema_ref NULL, workspace_handle_json NULL, workspace_handle_digest NULL, output_requirement_digest, episode_claim_set_digest, digest_algorithm, digest_hex, size_bytes, control_operation(assert_existing_input|acquire_workspace_product), expected_control_revision NULL, expected_control_projection_digest NULL, committed_control_revision, committed_control_projection_digest, member_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,material_key)`；一个Physical Material在同一Product Manifest只有一个业务role，ordinal从0连续且至少一个primary，只有primary允许Episode relation；`digest_algorithm=content_hash_algorithm=sha256`且`digest_hex=content_hash`，完整Physical Identity/Location/Binding/Requirement/Evidence可重建Product Material Manifest。`output_requirement_digest`必须按8.6.21从Package/Run共同引用的immutable Acceptance Spec及本Product member/relation重算并逐字节等于Manifest；assert variant固定domain location/Libra Binding，origin Delivery列全非NULL、Workspace/root-relative列全NULL且expected Control非NULL，其Physical Identity/Location/Binding/origin/expected Control逐项命中Run Input，Requirement因`manifestRole=product_delivery`按正式公式重新派生；acquire variant固定workspace location/Workspace Reference，origin/location列为NULL而root/relative及typed Handle JSON≤`4 KiB`逐字节命中current Product Staging Reference、expected Control为空并在Promotion事务取得revision 1；member/set digest按8.6.21唯一公式

`PK(on_deck_package_id,member_ordinal,episode_key)`并复合FK到Product member；只允许season primary payload；每个Material允许0..32个Episode，按episodeKey UTF-8 bytes排序；完整relation与`episode_claim_set_digest`必须按8.6.21逐字节重建，禁止只保存摘要或回读Run current scope补齐

entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,product_fact_id,fact_revision)`；按factKind/id/revision排序；必须逐项引用同Run immutable Product Fact；历史Package读取以该relation连接`libra_product_fact_revisions`并展开同一typed `fact_json`，完整Product Fact Manifest不依赖current row或另一Domain Store

entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_package_id FK, ordinal, material_key, context_role(original_input|structural_dependency), mount_scope_id, inode, content_hash_algorithm, content_hash, endpoint_id, location, binding_revision, binding_evidence_digest, admitted_control_revision, admitted_control_projection_digest, settlement_expectation(retain|replace_or_move|remove_after_place), context_member_digest`

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, offer_id, on_deck_package_id FK, package_digest, arca_acceptance_decision_id, arca_acceptance_decision_digest, result(accepted|rejected), handoff_receipt_id, handoff_receipt_digest, custody_id NULL, arca_binding_set_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, rejection_digest NULL, closure_digest NULL, received_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `receipt_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-delivery-receipt-id@1",offerId}))`，offer逐字节等于Package row且`UNIQUE(offer_id)`；accepted要求Custody/Binding/Control列非NULL、rejection/closure列NULL，并逐项无损保存`ArcaProductAcceptedMessage@1` Receipt；rejected要求Custody/Binding/Control列NULL且decision/receipt/rejection/closure digest逐项等于`ArcaProductRejectedMessage@1`与`LibraProductRejectionClosureResult@1`；terminal后immutable，相反终态稳定拒绝；`INDEX(result,received_at_ms)`

entries.constraintsContract: mount scope pair是Platform opaque technical ref；active Shelf name不作为identity；Shelf创建时routing projection revision=1，任何后续`status/current_standard_revision`变化都对该revision执行CAS并加1，再按`ShelfRoutingTargetProjection@1`公式重算digest；`INDEX(status,shelf_id)`；不得保存Libra Routing Priority
